src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bars = [(i, next((v for v in row if v != 0), 0)) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    period = len(bars)
    pattern = {}
    for i, color in bars:
        phase = i % period
        if phase in pattern and pattern[phase] != color:
            raise ValueError("inconsistent stripe period")
        pattern[phase] = color
    # Every pattern phase is represented by at least one bar for these tasks.
    return [[pattern[r % period]] * w for r in range(h)]
'''
